question: When was the first World Weightlifting Championship organized by the World Weightlifting Federation in London, UK?
solution:
The correct answer is** ​__March 1891.__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The first World Weightlifting Championship organized by the **World Weightlifting Federation** took place in** London, UK**, on **March 1, 1891.**
 
• This event marked a significant milestone in the sport of weightlifting, establishing a formal international competition
 
• **Currently the International Weightlifting Federation** **(IWF)** is the governing body for the sport of weightlifting worldwide.
 
• It was founded in **1905**
 
• Headquarters of the International Weightlifting Federation, it is located in **Budapest, Hungary.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Karnam Malleshwari** is the **first **Indian woman who won a **bronze medal in the **Sydney **Olympic (2000).**
 
• She is an** Indian weightlifter **and is now retired.
 
• She was the two-time weightlifting champion with 11 Gold medals out of 29 international medals before the Olympics.
 
• She was also awarded **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in 1995,** **Arjuna Award in 1994**, and **Padma Shri in 1999.**
